title: Food Bank of Central Louisiana
description: About Food Bank of Central Louisiana\ The Food Bank of Central Louisiana is a nonprofit organization dedicated to alleviating hunger in Central Louisiana through collaboration and food distribution programs. They provide assistance to over 42,500 households annually, offering resources such as SNAP applications and mobile pantry services. Their initiatives include programs aimed at strengthening children and nourishing seniors, addressing the specific needs of vulnerable populations. The organization encourages community involvement through donations and volunteer opportunities to support their mission. The Central Louisiana Food Bank was the victim of a cyberattack, resulting in the theft of more than 130 GB of confidential data. The stolen data includes documents such as banking and financial information, personal data of employees and clients, databases, and other important company information.
